entry.name: Shieldwall: Bottleneck

mechanics.effect: When you are in a narrow passage or holding a chokepoint, you gain advantage on attack rolls against creatures within 5 feet of you. Additionally, you can use your reaction to impose disadvantage on the next attack roll made against an ally within 5 feet of you.

lineage.rationale: Repeatedly used terrain to control enemy movement and protect allies, including a failed attempt to intercept an attack.

evidence: Brakka stood watch outside Maren's room.

entry.name: Warden's Duty: Gatekeeper

mechanics.effect: Use your action to repair a simple mechanical or structural object (like a gate or door) that is not destroyed, or to set up a watch position. On a success, the object functions normally or you gain a +2 bonus to Perception checks while on watch.

lineage.rationale: Demonstrated practical maintenance and protective vigilance in a fort setting.

entry.system_equivalent: Crafting and Perception support action (Dungeons & Dragons Fifth Edition (2024 rules))

lastAnalysis.notes:
s2 - toll king

- cinderford east gate, rain. toll king's collectors (capt Vesk) want 100g "bridge-breaker's tax" or a hostage
- brakka tied his own wrists w/ rope and offered to go, vesk backed off a bit
- wick stole the writ right off her glove (lol) - it just says "bring the one who fed the Silent One", no gold at all. he also accused the bell lady of working w/ vesk, she laughed at him
- luz tried the blessing token thing, got laughed at. later held up her symbol in front of the crowd and made it too public for vesk to draw
- maren NAT 20 persuasion, talked vesk down, no fight at the gate
- tovin took the rag-market woman's deal for real this time - gave her a year of his dreams. she told him the Silent One is a drowned god under the toll-fort and the toll king feeds it people who surrender
- brakka tried to get in front of tovin, slipped on the cobbles

- greyhook toll-fort: toll king + 4 drowned thralls out of the pool, hostage guard (Oren) tied up by the water
- brakka held the stone lip so they came one at a time, hacked one down
- maren entangle only got 1 of 4. then Thorn Lash on the one going for the wagon, pinned it, wick finished it off
- toll king drowned maren's lungs w/ pool water, she went down to half. luz healing word'd her
- wick cut Oren loose and hid him behind the wagon. cut steve loose to charge a thrall, steve just ran away
- tovin nat20 eldritch blast for 3 dmg 💀. then he told everyone the guard was "his coin", creepy
- wick yelled at vesk until she switched sides, collectors killed the other 2 thralls
- luz sanctuary on Oren (toll king shrugged it off), sacred flame, guiding bolt missed
- end: toll king offered tovin his crown. brakka lassoed him, maren thorn-whipped him out of the pool, wick threw a dagger through his hand
- tovin took the crown and made his patron EAT the silent one?? pool drained. toll king gave up, vesk arrested him. tovin kept the crown

- 2 days at the fort
- brakka fixed the gate, stood watch outside maren's room. couldn't find steve
- maren found steve in an orchard. her turnips in the pool silt rotted. bread w/ Oren was amazing, he told us the toll king fed 31 people to the pool. she got vesk to pay for fixing the shrine
- luz read all 31 names at the shrine, didn't work (yet). she's watching tovin
- wick found a hidden ledger page -> "the Lantern House in Varrow". also pocketed 30g. licked the shrine
- tovin got caught stealing old coins by vesk. crown just hums, toll king won't talk to him

next time: varrow / lantern house. who's bringing snacks. also can maren's thorn lash crit?? ask at start

entry.name: Verdant Snare: Thorn Lash

mechanics.effect: Make a spell attack roll against one creature within 30 feet. On a hit, the target takes 2d6 piercing damage and is Restrained until the end of your next turn. If the target is already Restrained, it instead takes an additional 1d6 piercing damage and is pushed 10 feet away from you.

lineage.rationale: Maren demonstrated a distinct combat style combining crowd control (entangle) with aggressive repositioning (thorn-whipping into hazards), suggesting a specialized use of plant magic for battlefield control.

entry.system_equivalent: Druid spell action (Dungeons & Dragons Fifth Edition (2024 rules))

entry.name: Grovekeeper: Field Triage

mechanics.effect: Attempt a Medicine check to treat one adjacent creature. On a success, the target regains 1d8 Hit Points. If the target is an animal or a humanoid who has surrendered or is not hostile, you gain advantage on the check.

lineage.rationale: Maren consistently provided medical aid to allies and even surrendered enemies, showing a dedicated and compassionate approach to healing that goes beyond simple spellcasting.

entry.system_equivalent: Medicine skill action (Dungeons & Dragons Fifth Edition (2024 rules))

evidence: Maren placed second in a bake-off with a lavender honey loaf.

entry.name: Honeycomb: Artisan's Trade

mechanics.effect: You gain proficiency with Cook's Utensils and Brewer's Supplies. When you sell or trade goods you have crafted or gathered (such as honey or baked goods), you can add your proficiency bonus to the DC for any Persuasion or Deception check made to negotiate a better price, and you earn 10% more gold from such sales.

lineage.rationale: Maren's success in selling honey and competing in a bake-off indicates a strong aptitude for artisanal production and commerce, which can be formalized as a craft and social skill.

entry.system_equivalent: Dungeons & Dragons Fifth Edition (2024 rules) feat (GM review)

entry.name: Verdant Snare: Warden's Bargain

mechanics.effect: When you succeed on a Persuasion check to convince a creature to stand down or pay a debt, you can use your reaction to grant that creature advantage on its next saving throw against a fear effect or a condition that would restrict its movement, representing the lingering weight of your authority.

lineage.rationale: Maren demonstrated a consistent ability to de-escalate conflicts and negotiate favorable terms with powerful entities like Vesk, showing a mastery of social control that complements her druidic authority.
